description: This file implements interrupt handling and trigger setup for the ADT7420 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including GPIO callbacks, thread management, and interrupt configuration.

methods.name: setup_int
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt for the ADT7420 device, enabling or disabling based on the 'enable' parameter.

methods.name: handle_int
methods.description: Handles the interrupt event by disabling further interrupts and signaling the appropriate thread or work queue.

methods.name: process_int
methods.description: Reads the status register, invokes the trigger handler if set, re-enables interrupts, and checks for pin assertion.

methods.name: adt7420_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, calls handle_int.

methods.name: adt7420_thread
methods.description: Dedicated thread function for handling interrupts when configured with OWN_THREAD.

methods.name: adt7420_work_cb
methods.description: Workqueue callback for handling interrupts when configured with GLOBAL_THREAD.

methods.name: adt7420_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets the trigger and handler for the sensor, configuring GPIO interrupts accordingly.

methods.name: adt7420_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for the device, setting up callbacks and threads.
